deployments_detail.use: Vertical AI platform (SymphonyAI, incl. CINDE) powering grocery retail transformation across the group: AI-driven supply-chain replenishment, real-time store execution/mobile collaboration, and end-to-end data & master management for unified visibility. [SymphonyAI (CINDE / connected retail suite)]
deployments_detail.value: none (only generic industry benchmarks cited: ~3.5% sales uplift, 20% inventory-turn improvement)

deployments_detail.use: AI-native demand forecasting and automated replenishment across retail and wholesale (store + distribution-center forecasting, fresh replenishment, order-accuracy improvement, supplier forecast sharing). Later reported as in production ensuring availability, optimizing stock levels and cutting costs. [RELEX Solutions (implementation partner Demandtex)]

AI planogram / shelf-space management: moving from manual planogram planning to automated, data-driven merchandising with AI-powered demand-based planogram generation and mobile store execution. Pilot completed and scaling across the network. [LEAFIO AI (Shelf Efficiency)]

Predictive analytics tools and a centralized data platform underpinning the group's shift to a 'data-driven' organization (behavioral analysis and decision support), reported deployed in 2024 under the LabelFactory digital-transformation program. [none named (LabelFactory)]

Intelligent anti-food-waste solution that automatically identifies and flags to store staff products approaching their expiry date (DLC) so they can be discounted, reducing waste. Deployed across Carrefour, Carrefour Market, Carrefour Express and Atacadao (reported at 134 stores). [CodaBene (DLC Mémo)]

Internal web-application built on an AI-based matching algorithm to connect the group's Business Units (matching needs/resources across BUs), described in the 2024 annual report (CAP 2028 program). [none named (internal, via LabelFactory digital factory)]
Dynamic / AI-assisted pricing tool for a more international-standard, data-driven pricing strategy, reported as rolled out in 2024. [none named]

Bringo by Carrefour e-commerce/home-delivery platform (built on commercetools) with a 'humanized' personal-shopper model and live in-app chat between customer, picker and driver for product substitutions/recommendations across 9 cities. [commercetools (e-commerce engine); personal-shopper/live-chat layer]
deployments_detail.value: NPS 71; ~EUR 60,000/day revenue in first month; app rating 4.3/5; +20% app traffic and +10-20% basket value during promotions
